definition: a title "as brave and strong as Hanumān”.
example_en: He was given the title 'as brave and strong as Hanumān'.

definition: to glow with low intensity.
example_en: A lamp was glowing faintly in the distance.

definition: nearness; closeness; proximity.
example: ಮಗುವಿನ ಜನ್ಮದ ಆಸನ್ನತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಲ್ಲೂ ಸಂತಸ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The nearness of the child's birth brought joy to everyone.

definition: the large vulture Gyps bengalensis of Acciptridae family, with bald-head, naked neck, white back and shoulder, large wings, short but strong curved beak, black legs, that feeds on dead animals; Indian white-backed vulure.
example: ರಣಪರ್ದು ಬಿಳಿ ಬೆನ್ನು ಮತ್ತು ಬೋಳು ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಗುರುತಿಸಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The Indian white-backed vulture is identified by its white back and bald neck.

definition: to flow continuously.
example_en: The mountain stream flowed continuously.

definition: the moon, as the master of stars.
example: ಧಿಷ್ಣ್ಯವರನು ರಾತ್ರಿಯ ಆಕಾಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಬೆಳಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: The moon shines among the stars in the night sky.

definition: (phys.) optical distortion resulting from the spherical shape of a lens or mirror; spherical aberration.
example_en: Spherical aberration was noticed in that lens.

definition: to cause to come in between; to make interfere.
example: ಅವನು ಮಾತಿನ ನಡುವೆ ಅನಗತ್ಯ ವಿಷಯ ಎಡೆತಾಕಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He caused an unnecessary matter to interfere in between the conversation.

definition: sodium borate, a white, anhydrous, crystalline salt, Na2B4O7, with an alkaline taste, used as a flux in soldering metals and in the manufacture of glass, enamel, artificial gems, soaps, antiseptics, etc.; borax.
example_en: They sell borax in the shop.

definition: to cover, daub with or rub oil or ointment on.
example_en: The grandmother rubbed oil on the child's body.

definition: a particular lock or hold in wrestling.
example_en: In the match he applied the dobi-pat hold.

definition: the pointed end (of a needle, thorn etc.).
example_en: The pointed tip of the needle was very sharp.

definition: to abandon - a) to leave completely and finally; to forsake utterly; to desert; b) to give up; to discontinue; to withdraw from; c) to give up the control of.
example_en: He abandoned his old habits.

definition: an imitative sound (as of a ripe tomato while bursting).
example_en: A cracking sound was heard when the tomato burst.

definition: former or first state.
example_en: After the treatment, he returned to his former state.

definition: a parasol, esp. the one held as a mark of respect, devotion on the head of a king, deity (taken on procession).
example_en: During the procession they held a parasol over the deity.

definition: a male insect.
example_en: The male insect was sitting on the leaf.

definition: cold milk.
example_en: They served cold milk to the guest.

definition: having a navel which is not deep.
example_en: He had a beautiful body with a shallow navel.

definition: a way of doing, being, being done or happening; mode of action, occurrence, etc.: manner.
example_en: His manner of speaking was different from others.

definition: a place of protection.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ದಾಪು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a place of protection at the foot of that hill.

definition: not lasting; temporary; transitory; brief.
example_en: This happiness is transitory, it will end soon.

definition: any animal that walks on the whole sole, as a human or bear; a plantigrade.
example_en: A human is a plantigrade animal.

definition: to read (a written letters, passage, etc.).
example_en: The child reads the lesson every day.

definition: sweet; delicious; honeyed.
example_en: The taste of this fruit is sweet and delicious.

definition: the act or bringing to or directing toward, a common centre; concentration.
example_en: The government carried out the concentration of all powers.

definition: to get the price for a commodity sold.
example_en: He gets a good price for old books.

definition: to cause to exert pressure or force to move an object, person, etc.
example: ಗಾಡಿ ಕೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಲುಕಿದಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಅದನ್ನು ನೂಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: When the cart got stuck in the mud, everyone pushed it.

definition: to humiliate an arrogant person.
example_en: The teacher's words humiliated the arrogant man.

definition: to become oily, greasy or be stuck with stubborn dirt.
example_en: The unused pan became stuck with grease in the corner.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example: ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಘಟನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು ವಖ್ಖಣೆಯನ್ನು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: The officer wrote a written statement about the incident.

definition: a deliberate false statement; a lie.
example_en: Everyone was deceived by his false statement.

definition: having, using, showing reason.
example_en: His words are always reasoned and logical.

definition: the act of breathing; respiration.
example_en: Deep breathing calms the mind.

definition: to become wet, damp or moist; to be moistened.
example_en: The ground became wet and damp due to the continuous rain.

definition: either side of the face between the nose and ear, below the eye; the cheek.
example_en: The child's cheek looked red.

definition: any of various wolflike carnivores (family Hyaenidae), with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry, fed on carrion; a hyena.
example_en: At night the hyena was eating the dead animal.

definition: a painful swelling of a vein in the region of the anus, that often bleeds; piles; haemorrhoids.
example_en: The doctor detected that he had internal piles.

definition: the blossom of a plant; a flower.
example_en: A white flower had bloomed on that plant.

definition: the daily appearance of the sun above the horizon in the morning; the sunrise.
example: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಸೂರ್ಯೋದಯವನ್ನು ನೋಡಲು ಅವನು ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಹತ್ತುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: He used to climb the hill every day to watch the sunrise.

definition: a woman of abnormally small stature; a dwarfish woman.
example: ಆ ಗುಜ್ಜಿ ಜಾತ್ರೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆದಳು.
example_en: That dwarfish woman drew everyone's attention at the fair.

definition: the spreading annual vine Arachis hypogea of Papilionaceae family with yellow flowers and brittle pods ripening underground and containing one to three edible seeds.
example_en: Groundnut grows well in this soil.

definition: to be separated lengthwise into two or more parts; to be split.
example_en: The dry tree branch split easily.

definition: the yam plant Dioscorea tomentosa of Dioscoreaceae family.
example_en: The white yam is not easily available.

definition: a virgin - a) an unmarried girl or woman; b) a woman, esp. a young woman, who has never had sexual intercourse.
example_en: That virgin girl had not yet gotten married.

definition: personal devotion to a particular deity.
example_en: She had immense devotion towards Krishna.

definition: to provide as a witness.
example_en: The judge asked that he be provided as a witness.

definition: an interclass marriage which was earlier prohibited on religious ground.
example: ಹಿಂದೆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣಸಂಕರವನ್ನು ಧರ್ಮದ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿರೋಧಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In the past, interclass marriage was opposed in the name of religion in society.

definition: (said of cattle) to eat; to graze.
example_en: The sheep were grazing in the open field.

definition: mean; low; vile; base.
example: ಅವನದು ಕುದ್ರ ಬುದ್ಧಿ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಆಡಿಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: Everyone remarked that his was a mean, base mind.

definition: any eatable in gen.; food.
example_en: They prepared various kinds of food for the festival.

definition: the art of embroidering.
example_en: She had known the art of embroidering since childhood.

definition: a man who washes clothes, linens, etc., for hire; laundryman.
example_en: The laundryman washed the clothes clean.

definition: mixed; made by combining two or more ingredients; blended.
example: ಈ ಬೆರಕೆ ಹಾಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನೀರು ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: A little water has got into this mixed milk.

definition: three and a half; 3.5.
example: ಆ ಕಂಬದ ಎತ್ತರ ಮುಯ್ಯರ್ಧ ಅಡಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The height of that pillar was three and a half feet.

definition: Sāmavēda, name of one of the four vedas.
example_en: The Samaveda is recited with singing.

definition: a mixing or being mixed; the state or fact of being joined, associated or mixed.
example_en: The joining of the two groups happened at the meeting.

definition: a haughty, insolent man.
example_en: That haughty man speaks with everyone in an insolent manner.

definition: a cut and polished gemstone or a pearl, used for ornamentation; a gem.
example_en: A shining gem was set in the king's crown.

definition: a rope tied to the feet together while climbing areca, coconut etc. trees.
example_en: He tied a rope to his feet and climbed the tree.

definition: the act of betrothing or fact of being betrothed; betrothal; engagement.
example_en: The betrothal was settled between the two families.

definition: a sound; noise.
example_en: The sound of the drum was heard from afar.

definition: [more appropriately Sanātana Dharma] the common system of life in India, expounded and evolved in the Vedas, the Upanishads, the Bhagavad-Gita, etc., being an extremely inclusive one which encompasses many schools of philosophy (as Atheism, Buddhism, Jainism, etc.) and theology, many popular cults, and a large pantheon symbolising the many attributes of a single god, which finally lead to a single Para Brahma, the Absolute and Supreme Being.
example_en: Hinduism includes the worship of many gods.

definition: to be in front or facing.
example_en: He stood in front at the meeting.

definition: to be medically treated; to get medical service.
example_en: The injured person got medically treated at the hospital.

definition: to remove the testes or make a person, animal impotent.
example_en: The farmers had the ox castrated.

definition: fixed at a place or point; settled; set up.
example_en: The idol of the god is fixed and installed in the sanctum.

definition: to go back; to retreat.
example_en: Having lost in the battle, he retreated.

definition: a supporting structure; a truss.
example_en: A strong supporting truss was installed for the bridge.

definition: a language that is clear, easily understood.
example_en: Everyone understood because of his clear language.

definition: the state of the mind being excited; excitement; excessive, sometimes unnatural, enthusiasm, zeal or fervour.
example: ಆಟ ಗೆದ್ದ ಸಂತೋಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನ ಕದುಬು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಯಿತು.
example_en: In the joy of winning the game, the excitement of his mind increased.

definition: (an arrow, bullet, etc.) to hit the target.
example_en: The archer's arrow hit the target.

definition: the head of a cow.
example_en: They roasted the cow's head in the kitchen to eat.

definition: choked speech; an indistinct sound.
example: ಜ್ವರದಿಂದ ಬಳಲುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಗಗ್ಗರದನಿ ಕೇಳಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Weakened by fever, choked speech was heard in his words.

definition: a bad lineage.
example_en: People gossiped that his lineage was bad.

definition: the boundaries of a piece of land (as a farm-land).
example_en: The boundaries of the land are clearly marked with stone markers.

definition: a red curtain or veil.
example_en: They had hung a red curtain on the window.

definition: (collectively) perfumes, aromatic substances.
example_en: Various kinds of perfumes and aromatic substances were being sold in the shop.

definition: a religious nun belonging to the digambara clan of Jainas.
example_en: That Jain nun sat in meditation all day long.

definition: the terminal part of the leg in vertebrates, below the ankle joint, on which the body stands and moves; a foot.
example_en: His foot got injured.

definition: the Almighty; the Supreme Being.
example_en: The devotees bowed their heads and prayed before the Almighty.

definition: a natural pond or pool of water; a bay.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಆಖಾತ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful natural pool at the foot of the hill.

definition: the act of going back or to previous position or place; a withdrawal retreat.
example_en: The retreat of the enemy army changed the course of the war.

definition: the act of bringing something (as dilapidated building) back to its original or near original stage, by repairing, reconstructing, etc.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕೋಟೆಯ ನವಕರ್ಮ ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ಖರ್ಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The restoration of the old fort was carried out at government expense.

definition: one who is subject to or suffering from the carnal passions.
example_en: Being a slave to carnal passions, he would lust after any woman he saw.

definition: a staying, being or living together.
example: ಅವರ ಸಂಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: Their living together had lasted many years.

definition: a statement, remark; one word.
example_en: He spoke only one word/remark.

definition: a man working for earning money on hourly, daily or piecework basis.
example: ಆ ಮಜೂರ ದಿನವಿಡೀ ಕಷ್ಟಪಟ್ಟು ಇಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹೊತ್ತನು.
example_en: That daily-wage worker toiled all day carrying bricks.

definition: to get, obtain or scheme a plan, stratagem.
example_en: He schemed a plan to escape from the problem.

definition: the state or condition of being deficient; deficiency.
example_en: Deficiency of nutrients in food is harmful to health.

definition: a mechanical apparatus for doing some specific work, with less manual labour; a machine.
example_en: That machine stopped working.

definition: a beautiful idol.
example: ಆ ಮಂದಿರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರವಾದ ಚಿತ್ರಪುತ್ತಳಿ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a beautiful idol in that temple.

definition: the act of crushing, grinding or pulverising.
example_en: The machine carried out the crushing of the stones.

definition: to wrap up; to cover completely.
example_en: She wrapped the baby completely in cloth.

definition: a long life (of a person).
example_en: That sage attained a long life.

definition: to vie for supremacy.
example_en: The two players vied for the prize.

definition: to play with pebbles.
example_en: The children were playing with pebbles on the porch.

definition: to put off to a later time; to defer; to postpone.
example: ಅವನು ಸಭೆಯ ದಿನವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ವಾರ ವಿಲಂಬಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He postponed the day of the meeting by a week.

definition: to make something equal to (another).
example_en: He said to make the two parts equal.

definition: air in motion; wind.
example: ರಯಗ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಬೀಸಿ ಮಳೆ ಬರುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ನೀಡಿತು.
example_en: The wind blew strongly, giving a sign that rain was coming.

definition: a natural habitation of bees; a beehive.
example_en: There was a beehive in the hollow of the tree.

definition: the quality of a wicked, depraved or iniquitous person.
example: ಆ ಮನುಷ್ಯನ ಪೋಕಾಟ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಗೊತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone in the village knew about that man's depravity.

definition: the plant Azima tetracantha of Salvadoraceae family; thorn berry plant.
example_en: The thorns of the elace plant prick.

definition: a variety of ants; black ant.
example_en: Black ants were going in a line in the garden.

definition: to become dull; to lose brightness, lustre.
example_en: Due to use, that ornament had become dull and lost its lustre.

definition: to be afraid of; to dread; to fear; to dread.
example_en: The children were afraid on the dark path.

definition: a small flat ornament, with a jewel, worn as a frontlet at the partition of hair in combing.
example_en: On her wedding day she wore the frontlet ornament.

definition: to feel fear; to be afraid.
example_en: She feels afraid when alone in the dark.

definition: a kind of antidote.
example_en: The physician used the tarkshya-shaila as an antidote for the poison.

definition: a hand holding a sword.
example_en: The warrior with a sword in his hand charged toward the enemy.

definition: an afflicted person.
example_en: The whole village helped that afflicted person.

definition: a violent, reckless, destructive behaviour; rampage.
example_en: The army carried out a rampage in the village.

definition: a woman who rules others or has control, authority or power over something esp. a) a woman who is the head of a household or institution; b) an employer; c) one who owns a slave or an animal; a mistress.
example: ಆ ಮನೆಯ ಅಧೀಶ್ವರಿ ಎಲ್ಲರನ್ನೂ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನಿಂದ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: The mistress of that household manages everyone with discipline.

definition: that which is round; a circular thing.
example: ಆ ಬಟುಹು ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಮಕ್ಕಳು ಆಟವಾಡಲು ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: The children used that round stone to play.

definition: the experience of the mind (as dif. from that of the body).
example_en: Through meditation, he gained an inner experience of the mind.

definition: absence of fatigue; tirelessness.
example_en: Yoga practice brought him tirelessness.

definition: a man destitute of teeth.
example: ಆ ಮುದುಕ ಬೋಸನಾಗಿ ಮೆತ್ತಗಿನ ಆಹಾರವನ್ನೇ ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That old man, being toothless, ate only soft food.

definition: a fraction - a) an indicated quotient of two whole numbers;, b) any quantity expressed in terms of a numerator and denominator.
example_en: They taught about fractions in the mathematics lesson.

definition: made of iron.
example_en: That iron door was very heavy.

definition: the work of preparing the food; cooking.
example_en: Mother is cooking in the morning.

definition: a man who levels (a piece of land).
example_en: The man who levels land made the field flat and even.

definition: a deep groove, furrow or track, esp. one made in the ground by the passage of wheeled vehicles.
example_en: A deep rut formed on the road from the carts passing by.

definition: one of the men who heralds by turn; an official herald.
example: ಸೂೞಾಯ್ತ ಬೀದಿ ಬೀದಿಗೆ ಹೋಗಿ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಸಾರಿದನು.
example_en: The official herald went from street to street proclaiming the news.

definition: strongly; vigorously.
example_en: He shouted out strongly.

definition: the study of langage that deals with forms and structures of words, phrases, sentences, sounds and meanings; grammar.
example_en: They taught us Kannada grammar at school.

definition: the quality of being valorous; valiance.
example_en: That warrior's valiance was known to everyone.

definition: to extend oneself over a wide or wider area; to be diffused throughout.
example_en: The rainwater spread throughout the field.

definition: the railway transportation system.
example_en: The villagers demanded a new railway line.

definition: a totally stupid fellow.
example_en: He is a totally stupid fellow, he understands nothing.

definition: a brush made of a bundle of straw or stiff strands of synthetic material bound tightly at one end; a broom.
example_en: She swept the yard with a broom.

definition: the end of anything; finish.
example: ಸಿನಿಮಾ ಶೂಟಿಂಗ್ ಖಲಾಸು ಆಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದಂತೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಚಪ್ಪಾಳೆ ತಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: As soon as the film shooting finished, everyone clapped.

definition: readiness or liberality in giving generosity.
example_en: The poor were helped because of his generosity.

definition: to sustain wound, injury.
example_en: His leg was wounded in the forest.

definition: the state or the religious status of a woman whose husband is alive.
example_en: She performed worship in the status of a married woman with a living husband.

definition: the condition of being subject to pain, grief, trouble, etc.; misery.
example_en: The misery of poverty troubled him greatly.

definition: (the eye) to burn; to have inflammatory sensation.
example_en: His eyes were burning because dust had gotten into them.

definition: a flight through outer space; space-flight.
example_en: The scientists undertook a space-flight towards the moon.

definition: a thing that which is short, dwarf.
example_en: That tree grew up short and dwarfish.

definition: a formal request in writing addressed to a judicial authority requesting for redressing, compensation etc.; a petition.
example_en: She filed a petition at the police station.

definition: a miserable state of living; decadence.
example: ಯುದ್ಧದ ನಂತರ ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಅಸುಗತಿಗೆ ಇಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After the war, that kingdom fell into a miserable state.

definition: the condition of being or remaining a virgin.
example_en: She preserved her virginity throughout her life.

definition: affectionately handled; fondled; caressed; cherished.
example_en: The mother picked up the child affectionately, fondling it.

definition: rule or domination in a despotic way; despotism; authoritarianism.
example: ಆ ರಾಜನ ಒತ್ತಾಳಿಕೆ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಹಳ ಕಂಗೆಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: That king's despotic rule greatly troubled the citizens.

definition: a man given to excessive sensual indulgence.
example: ಆ ಕಚ್ಚೆಹರುಕ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಟ್ಟ ಹೆಸರು ಪಡೆದಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That lecherous man has earned a bad name in the village.

definition: the front portion of the part of the body connecting the head to the shoulders; the neck.
example_en: There was a gold chain on her neck.

definition: a water-passage; a channel.
example_en: The children were playing near the channel.

definition: the flowering plant Canna indica of Cannaceae family; Indian shot.
example_en: The Indian shot plant bears red flowers.

definition: a system for transmitting speech or computerised information over distances; a telephone.
example: ಅವಳು ಗೆಳತಿಗೆ ಫೋನು ಮಾಡಿ ಸುದ್ದಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She called her friend on the phone and told her the news.

definition: a division of a whole.
example_en: The division of the property took place among the brothers.

definition: a hailing cry 'victory unto thee!.
example_en: The crowd marched shouting 'jindabad', victory unto him.

definition: suddenly and brightly.
example_en: The lightning flashed suddenly and brightly in the sky.

definition: to break up and level ploughed ground, cover seeds, root up weeds, etc. by drawing a harrow; to harrow.
example_en: The farmer harrowed the field and sowed the seeds.

definition: a merciful, gracious man.
example: ಆ ಪರಸನ್ನ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That merciful man always helped the poor.

definition: busy and noisy activity caused by enthusiasm, excitement, etc.; bustle.
example_en: There was much bustle in the market on the festival day.

definition: the act or an instance of despatching (goods, letters, parcels, troops, etc.) to another place; a despatch.
example: ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್ ರವಾನೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಅಂಚೆ ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ ಹೋದೆನು.
example_en: I went to the post office to despatch the parcel.

definition: a game of gambling which a large number of tickets are sold and a drawing is held for certain prizes; lottery.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ವಾರ ಜನರು ಲಾಟರಿ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಖರೀದಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Every week, people buy lottery tickets.

definition: a tax or toll.
example_en: Traders must pay tax to the government.

definition: to shoot out sprout; to sprout.
example_en: The sown seed sprouted after the rain.

definition: parched, seasoned pulses.
example_en: Grandmother roasted the parched pulses in a pan.

definition: a man liberated from the worldly bonds; a sage.
example_en: That liberated sage lived peacefully in the forest.

definition: excessively; abundantly.
example_en: The rain poured excessively.

definition: a soggy ground that look hard; a deceptive soft soil.
example_en: One who went carelessly got stuck in the deceptive soft soil.

definition: a fiery eye.
example_en: In anger, his fiery eyes turned red and blazed.

definition: the quality of an envious man; envy; jealousy.
example: ಅವನ ಕಱುಬತನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರ ನಡುವೆ ಜಗಳ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His jealousy caused a quarrel among the friends.

definition: the cheapest class in a passenger train or theatre.
example_en: The poor passengers bought tickets in the cheapest class.

definition: a hollow object, usu. inverted cone or cuplike, made of metal or other hard material, with a clapper inside, which rings when struck; a bell.
example_en: The priest rang the bell during the ārati.

definition: uncultivated land; fallow land.
example_en: The village's fallow land was made ready for ploughing again.

definition: to remove (an evil, difficulty, pain, heat, agony, etc.).
example_en: The medicine removed the suffering of the fever.

definition: a kind of vīṇe, a stringed musical instrument.
example_en: She sang while plucking the āḷaviṇe.

definition: any large rock; a big boulder.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಂಡಶಿಳಾತಳ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The big boulder on the hill drew everyone's attention.

definition: the act of folding.
example_en: She folded the clothes and arranged them.

definition: with a series of small, short, light, ringing sounds like those of a very small bell.
example_en: The bell made a tinkling sound.

definition: good; excellent.
example: ಇದು ನಲ್ ಫಸಲು ಎಂದು ರೈತ ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer said this is a good crop.

definition: a bad news.
example_en: Bad news came to that house today.

definition: (pl.) five entrances.
example_en: That fort had five entrances.

definition: a message or communication sent by telegraph; a telegraphic message.
example: ಗ್ರಾಮಕ್ಕೆ ತಂತಿವಾರ್ತೆ ತಲುಪಲು ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took two days for the telegraphic message to reach the village.

definition: the cardinal number thirty; 30.
example_en: There are thirty books in this box.

definition: pleased; satisfied.
example_en: He became pleased on hearing the result.

definition: a hand-operated or power-driven apparatus for weaving fabrics, containing harnesses, lay, reed, shuttles, treadles, etc.; a loom.
example_en: The weaver sat at the loom weaving cloth.

definition: a kind of plant.
example_en: The neladoṇḍe plant is used for medicine.

definition: shortage in weight.
example_en: A slight shortage in weight was found in the bag.

definition: to scratch with the finger nails.
example_en: The cat scratched the door with its claws.

definition: a group of sheep; a flock or herd.
example_en: The shepherd grazed the flock of sheep on the hill slope.

definition: to drive away.
example_en: He drove away the dogs that had come.

definition: a hard grip with the fist.
example_en: He struck the door with a tight fist.

definition: to make ready; to keep something prepared for.
example_en: She kept the food ready early in the morning.

definition: the art or occupation of a potter; pottery.
example_en: His pottery craft was famous in the village.

definition: the organ of sight; the eye.
example_en: Her eyes were very sharp.

definition: a thin slice or small piece of potato, green banana, etc. salted and spiced, fried in oil, that is used as food; a chip.
example_en: Mother made potato chips for the children.

definition: a device for recording on magnetic tape and for playing back what has been recorded.
example_en: He listened to the song on the old tape recorder.

definition: a nail on the toes of a tiger.
example_en: The hunter was frightened when he saw the tiger's claw.

definition: the act of compressing; a squeezing or crushing.
example_en: Juice came out from the crushing of the sugarcane.

definition: outstandingly good of its kind; of exceptional merit, virtue, etc.; excellent; superior; eminent.
example_en: His writing is marked by exceptional skill.

definition: one who drinks; a drinker.
example: ಆ ಪಾನಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಂಜೆ ಹೆಂಡ ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That drinker used to drink toddy every evening.

definition: to kill; to cause to die.
example_en: The army got ready to kill the enemies.

definition: reputation arising from success, achievement, rank or other favourable attributes; prestige.
example: ಅವನ ಸಾಧನೆಯಿಂದ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ತರ್ಕು ಬಂತು.
example_en: His achievement brought him good prestige in the town.

definition: a pit or hallow in the ground with still water; a small pond.
example_en: The children played in the water of the small pond.

definition: (in pl.) buildings, as houses and temples.
example_en: The houses and temples of the town are very old.

definition: to cause to flow in a stream; to pour down.
example_en: The rain poured water down from the sky.

definition: to pair - a) to arrange or designate in pairs or groups of two; b) to form into a pair, as by matching, joining.
example_en: The teacher paired the students two by two.

definition: preceding all other in a series; before any other; first.
example: ಈ ಸ್ಪರ್ಧೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳೇ ಪೈಲಾ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಪಡೆದಳು.
example_en: She got the first place in this competition.

definition: a kind of ear-ornament having a bunch-like pendant.
example_en: She wore a bunch-pendant ear-ornament in her ear.

definition: a pile, mass or mound of things jumbled together; a collection of things thrown one on another; a heap.
example_en: A heap of garbage lay in the courtyard.

definition: the tree Chukrasia tabularis of Meliaceae family; Jamaica cedar.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕರಡಿ ಮರಗಳಿಂದ ಅಮೂಲ್ಯ ಮರಮುಟ್ಟು ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Valuable timber is obtained from the karadi trees in that forest.

definition: a sloping side of a mountain.
example_en: The shepherds were grazing the sheep on the mountain slope.

definition: to take rest; to have an unocupied time to refresh oneself from fatigue, exhaustion .
example_en: The travellers took rest in the shade of the tree.

definition: a sub-caste among weavers.
example_en: People of the Kamadi sub-caste are traditionally weavers.

definition: a glass not letting light pass through; an opaque glass.
example_en: They fitted an opaque glass to the window.

definition: a reinforcing unit of an army.
example: ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪಡಿಬಳವನ್ನು ಮುಂಚೂಣಿ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಸಹಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Reinforcement troops were sent to help the front-line army at the border.

definition: a going back; return.
example_en: He undertook the journey of return to his village.

definition: the act of running; a run.
example_en: The children were running about in the playground.

definition: to break and reduce into very small pieces.
example_en: The grandmother broke the jaggery into small pieces.

definition: an act, behaviour or speech that is deliberately insincere, deceptive or misleading act.
example_en: People were deceived by his misleading behaviour.

definition: the quality of being not at ease with others or being bashful; shyness; bashfulness.
example: ಆ ಹುಡುಗನಿಗೆ ಜನರ ಮುಂದೆ ಜಲ್ಲು ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: That boy feels shy in front of people.

definition: a woman who is literate.
example: ಆಕೆ ಆ ಊರಿನ ಮೊದಲ ಅಕ್ಷರಜ್ಞೆ ಎಂದು ಹೆಸರಾದಳು.
example_en: She became known as the first literate woman of that town.

definition: a maid servant.
example_en: The maid servant came to work early in the morning.

definition: the vine Citrullus vulgaris of Cucurbitaceae family.
example_en: The Citrullus vulgaris vine spread across the farmer's field.

definition: a large, fierce hound.
example_en: The fierce hound ran with the hunter in the forest.

definition: wide knowledge; scholarship.
example: ಆ ಗುರುಗಳ ವಿಂದಾಣ ಇಡೀ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That teacher's scholarship was famous throughout the town.

definition: came down; displaced to a lower place.
example_en: The legend says that the god descended to earth.

definition: shining brightly; radiant; brilliant.
example_en: The bright radiance of the morning sun lit up the whole sky.

definition: an advanced, higher rank, position in a hierarchy.
example_en: He attained a high rank in the army.

definition: a written statement, account, declaration, assertion or explanation.
example_en: They had a written statement drawn up and recorded at the village panchayat.

definition: excessive frequency and looseness of bowel movements; diarrhoea.
example: ಕಲುಷಿತ ನೀರು ಕುಡಿದು ಅವನಿಗೆ ಉಚ್ಚಲಾಟ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He got diarrhoea after drinking contaminated water.

definition: a farmer; a peasant; an agriculturist.
example: ಆ ಭರಣಿಗ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಹೊಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದಾನೆ.
example_en: That farmer has been working in the field since morning.

definition: a plain and open field.
example_en: That open field is very flat.

definition: height; elevation.
example_en: The elevation of the tower was very high.

definition: a wood or metal bar or rod used to fasten a door; a bolt.
example_en: They secured the house by putting a bolt on the door.

definition: to cause to tell, narrate.
example_en: The teacher made the student narrate the story.

definition: a variety of parrot.
example_en: There was a royal parrot in that cage.

definition: the manner of doing anything with imagination to satisfy aesthetically; artistic skill.
example_en: His artistic skill won everyone's admiration.

definition: attractiveness; loveliness; beauty.
example: ಆ ಹೂವಿನ ಸವರು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The beauty of that flower drew everyone's attention.

definition: to give, send or do (something) what has been given or sent.
example_en: The soldier gave back the sword he had received.

definition: to be obedient to; to be submissive.
example_en: The servants were obedient to their master.

definition: to make (a fruit) ripen; to ripen.
example_en: The sunshine ripened the mango quickly.

definition: to cut or reap partially.
example_en: Due to lack of time, they reaped the crop only partially.

definition: a small, hard seed or seedlike fruit, esp. that of any cereal plant, as wheat, rice, etc. ; grain.
example_en: They had stored the grain in the granary.

definition: the act of writing.
example_en: The writing of the inscription is in old Kannada.

definition: a wooden plank used as a roofing for a house.
example_en: They laid a wooden plank as roofing for the house.

definition: white colour.
example_en: The white colour of the clean cloth was pleasing to the eye.

definition: any bird.
example_en: A bird was perched on the tree.

definition: a stone-pestle.
example_en: Grandmother ground the spices with the stone pestle.

definition: a conducting or managing of a business or directing the affairs of a company, firm, etc.
example: ಅವಳ ವೈವಾಟಿ ಕೌಶಲ ಕಂಪನಿಗೆ ಲಾಭ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: Her management skill brought profit to the company.

definition: a wall surrounding a building.
example_en: The old temple's surrounding wall had collapsed.

definition: to cause to wipe, mop, swab, etc.
example_en: The mother made her son wipe the floor.

definition: the fasting of Muslim people during the Ramadan month.
example_en: Muslims fast during the Ramadan fasting until sunset.

definition: a sympathetic, kindly man.
example: ಆ ಹೃದಯಸಂಪನ್ನ ಬಡ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಒದಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: That kind-hearted man provided education for poor children.

definition: a pin bent back on itself so as to form a spring, and having the point covered and held with a guard; a safety pin.
example_en: She fastened a safety pin to her sari.

definition: a playing, the art of playing, of marionette puppets.
example_en: A marionette puppet show was performed at the fair.

definition: a woman with proper respect for herself.
example_en: She is a self-respecting woman; she does not tolerate insult.

definition: (masc.) a wayfarer.
example_en: I showed the way to the wayfarer.

definition: any of various waterlilies of Nymphaeaceae family, a) the white lotus (Nymphaea lotus), b) the pink or white Asian lotus (Nelumbo nucifera), used as a religious symbol in Hinduism and Buddhism; c) blue lotus Nymphaea nouchali (= N. Pubescens) - and their flowers.
example_en: A white lotus had bloomed and stood in the pond.

definition: the quality or state of behaving at one's will or capriciously; capriciousness.
example_en: His capriciousness caused worry to his family.

definition: the form of a solid with six equal, square sides:.
example_en: That sculpture had been carved in the shape of a cube.

definition: to undergo pain; to be inflicted.
example_en: He suffered pain from the injury sustained in the fall.

definition: to be restricted or obstructed; to have an impediment.
example_en: The movement of vehicles was obstructed on the muddy road.

definition: that which is seen; sight.
example_en: The sight of the sunset from the hill was beautiful.

definition: not pleasant; offensive; disagreeable; unpleasant.
example: ಅವನ ಅಲೀಕ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕಸಿವಿಸಿ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His disagreeable behaviour caused discomfort to everyone.

definition: to go back to original or previous position or place; to retreat.
example_en: Out of fear she retreated and ran home.

definition: the water.
example_en: In the Vedas, water is described as the basis of life.

definition: a looking back on; retrospective view or survey, as of past events or experiences; a review.
example_en: He was immersed in a retrospective review of his childhood.

definition: the act of driving back or away.
example_en: The army's driving back forced the enemies to retreat.

definition: the act or fact of being or the quality of a rake, libertine; libertinism.
example: ಅವನ ವಿಟಗಾರಿಕೆಯ ನಡವಳಿಕೆ ಊರಿಗೆ ಸಿಟ್ಟು ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His libertine behaviour angered the whole town.

definition: a feeling of extreme repugnance or aversion; utter loathing; abomination; abhorrence.
example: ಆ ಕೊಳಕು ನೋಡಿ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಪೇಸು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that filth, she felt utter loathing.

definition: uncleaned grains.
example_en: Before taking it to the mill, they separated the uncleaned grains.

definition: that which is assumed without proof or as self-evident esp. as a basis for argument; a postulate.
example: ಈ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತವು ಒಂದು ಆಧಾರಪ್ರತಿಜ್ಞೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನಿಂತಿದೆ.
example_en: This theory rests upon a postulate.

definition: an open porch or portico, usu. roofed, along the outside of a building; a verandah.
example_en: During the rainy season they dried the clothes in the verandah.

definition: a kind of ornament, worn by children, in the shape of the nails of a tiger, stringed into a necklace.
example_en: They put a necklace of tiger-nail ornaments on the child's neck.

definition: a man who slaughters or commits a massacre.
example_en: People looked at that murderer with fear.

definition: to become soft, tender.
example_en: The new leaves became soft and tender.

definition: little; small.
example_en: He did not have even a little wisdom.

definition: a kind of drama, having one act, on any light theme or adventure.
example_en: The artists staged a beautiful one-act vilasike drama.

definition: having been exhausted, tired; wearily; tiredly.
example: ಇಡೀ ದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ ಅವನು ಚೊಮ್ಮನೆ ಮನೆ ಸೇರಿದನು.
example_en: Having worked the whole day, he reached home wearily.

definition: differently; in a different way.
example_en: He behaved differently from what he had said.

definition: any piece of certain kinds of material, as iron, that has the property of attracting like material; a magnet.
example_en: The children picked up iron bits using the magnet.

definition: superiority in quality, quantity or number; pre-eminence; eminence; excellence.
example_en: That student has special pre-eminence in mathematics.

definition: to open a door.
example_en: He opened the door.

definition: to come down; to descend.
example_en: It is said in the Purana that God descended to the earth.

definition: the plant Atalantia monophylla (=Limonia monophylla) of Rutaceae family.
example_en: The wild orange plant had grown at the edge of the garden.

definition: richness of a crop.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಭತ್ತದ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಪುಲುಸು ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: This year the paddy crop has gained good richness.

definition: the first day of any calendar month.
example_en: The first day of this month falls on a Monday.

definition: a beggar's bowl.
example_en: The beggar stood on the street holding his begging bowl.

definition: a very generous donor.
example_en: He was a very generous donor, who gave everything to the poor.

definition: (masc.) a suprme leader; an absolute leader; a supremo.
example_en: The supreme leader of the village used to solve everyone's problems.

definition: to become fit to be sung in chorus or with an orchestra.
example_en: After the singers' practice, the song became fit to be sung in chorus.

definition: the hemispherical roof of a multi-storeyed building.
example_en: The temple's hemispherical roof is visible from afar.

definition: a wide extent of level country; a plain land.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ವಿಶಾಲವಾದ ಮೋಳೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a wide plain land around that town.

definition: the inner, softer part of a nut, fruit pit, etc.; the kernel.
example_en: They carefully separated the kernel of the fruit.

definition: a new or the latest order or command.
example_en: The government issued a new order today.

definition: monochromatic - a) having only one colour; b) of, producing or having electromagnetic radiation of one wavelength only; c) of or having to do with total colour-blindness in which all objects appear as shades of grey.
example: ಏಕತರಂಗೀಯ ಬೆಳಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಸ್ತುಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಬಣ್ಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: In monochromatic light, objects appear in only one colour.

definition: great joy or pleasure.
example_en: Great joy arose in them from the child's smile.

definition: to make a loud vocal sound or utterance; to sob and shed tears in expressing sorrow, pain, grief, etc.; to weep; to cry.
example_en: Having lost her child, that mother wept.

definition: a store-house inside a house.
example_en: They filled the grains in the store-house inside the house.

definition: an young leaf of a plant.
example_en: The young leaf of the plant was shining green.

definition: the act of crossing over (as from one bank of a river to the other).
example_en: Crossing the river by boat was difficult.

definition: the light inside a place.
example_en: The light inside the cave was dim.

definition: the office, status or duties of the chief of a village.
example_en: The office of village chief had come to that family for generations.

definition: (dial.) a slender, threadlike structure that combines with others to form vegetable tissue; a fibre.
example_en: The fibre of the cloth was very thin.

definition: a man accepting reason as the only authority in determining his opinions or course of action; a rationalist.
example: ವಿಚಾರಪರ ಯಾವುದೇ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಕಾರಣ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ನಂಬುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: A rationalist does not believe anything without reason.

definition: a kind of stringed musical instrument.
example_en: The sound of that stringed instrument was distinctive.

definition: a thing to sit on, as chair, bench, throne, etc.; a seat.
example: ರಾಜ ಔಶೀರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಆಸ್ಥಾನ ನೋಡಿದನು.
example_en: The king sat on the seat and observed the court.

definition: to flash for a very short period, as a lightning.
example_en: That light flashed by for just a moment.

definition: a small quantity of ash, infused with magical power of keeping another or others spellbound, submissive etc.
example: ಜೋಗಿ ಆಕೆಗೆ ಮೋಹನಚೂರ್ಣ ಹಾಕಿ ವಶಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡನೆಂದು ಜನ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: People said the mendicant enchanted her with magic ash and brought her under his control.

definition: a piece of land where shrubs and grass have grown abundantly.
example_en: Cattle were grazing in the shrub-land outside the village.

definition: waste matter expelled from the bowels; excrement; faeces.
example_en: The baby's excrement needed to be cleaned up.

definition: vegetable - a) any herbaceous plant that is eaten whole or in part, raw or cooked; b) the edible part of such a plant, as the root (e.g., a carrot), tuber (a potato), seed (a pea), fruit (a tomato), stem (celery) or leaf (lettuce).
example_en: Fresh vegetables are available at the shop.

definition: a bumble-bee.
example_en: A bumble-bee was buzzing around the flower.

definition: (pl.) beloved persons.
example_en: The beloved ones always stay in her mind.

definition: to stab , pierce heavily.
example_en: He stabbed the enemy heavily with a sword.

definition: to purify and make more glittering (by or as by melting in fire).
example_en: The goldsmith purified the gold by melting it and made it glitter.

definition: the large, deciduous tree Schleichera trijuga of Sapindaceae with fluted stem and paripinnate leaves and hard, strong wood.
example: ಸಾಗಡೆ ಮರದ ಗಟ್ಟಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿಗೆಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಬಾಗಿಲು ಮಾಡಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They had a door made from the hard wood of the Schleichera tree.

definition: (myth.) the food of the gods; ambrosia.
example: ಪುರಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಮದು ದೇವತೆಗಳ ಆಹಾರ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿದೆ.
example_en: The purana says that ambrosia is the food of the gods.

definition: a connected group; a cluster; a bunch.
example_en: A cluster of children was playing in the field.

definition: (collectively) soldiers or military units that fight on foot; infantry.
example: ತಳತಂತ್ರ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ದಾಳಿ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The infantry soldiers attacked the enemies.

definition: a stick, rod carried in the hand; a hand-staff.
example_en: The shepherd held a hand-staff and tended the sheep.

definition: a parasite a) a person who lives at the expense of another or others without making any useful contribution or return; hanger-on; b) (biol.) a plant or animal that lives so.
example: ಆ ಸೋಮಾರಿ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಕರ ಮೇಲೆ ಉಪಜೀವಿಯಾಗಿ ಬದುಕುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That lazy man lives as a parasite dependent on his relatives.

definition: the status or condition of a citizen of a nation; citizenship.
example_en: He obtained the citizenship of that country.

definition: the bird Turdus ginginianus.
example_en: The Turdus ginginianus bird was resting in the shade of a tree.

definition: requested or asked for; desired.
example: ಅವಳಿಂದ ಅರ್ಥಿತ ಸಹಾಯ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: The help requested from her was received right on time.

definition: to meet and welcome respectfully; to give a warm reception.
example_en: The villagers went and gave the arriving teacher a warm welcome.

definition: people employed for spying.
example_en: The king sent spies to the enemy camp.

definition: expression of gratitude; grateful acknowledgment of something received by or done for one; thanks.
example_en: He said thanks for the help rendered.

definition: an unpleasant often strong emotion caused by anticipation or awareness of danger.
example: ಹಾವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಭೀ ಹುಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: Seeing the snake, fear arose in his mind.

definition: the tree Carica papaya of Caricaceae family, having a bunch of large leaves at the top; papaya tree.
example_en: We have grown a papaya tree in the backyard.

definition: to annoy or harass by persistent mocking or poking fun, playful fooling, etc. ; to tease.
example_en: His friends were teasing him just for fun.

definition: name of a petty goddess.
example: ಮಸಣಿಗೆ ದೇವಿಗೆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನರು ಪೂಜೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The village people worshipped the goddess Masanige.

definition: a modern type of formal logic using special symbols for propositions, quantifiers, and relationships among propositions and concerned with the elucidation of permissible operations upon such symbols; mathematical logic.
example_en: The students learned the symbols of mathematical logic.

definition: not shackled; not restrained; unfettered.
example_en: The unfettered animal roamed freely in the forest.

definition: to reprimand or scold with strong words.
example_en: The father scolded his son for not doing the work.

definition: to express; to communicate through words, gestures, etc.
example_en: He clearly expressed his opinion.

definition: to jump over from one side to another.
example_en: The boy easily jumped over the wall.

definition: the quality of being dirty, unsanitary, unhygienic, etc.
example_en: No one tolerates the filthiness of that locality.

definition: that which has the sharp, acid taste of lemon juice, vinegar, green fruit, etc.; a sour thing.
example_en: This fruit has a sour taste.

definition: (the depth) to be reduced; to become shallow.
example: ಮಳೆ ನಿಂತ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆರೆಯ ನೀರು ಗುಂಪಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After the rain stopped, the lake's water became shallow.

definition: to labour, perform service and get salary, wages, etc.; to earn.
example: ಅವನು ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಮಾಡಿ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಹಣ ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He did business and earned good money.

definition: the philanthropic donor of food.
example: ಆ ಮಠದ ಅನ್ನದ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬಡವರಿಗೆ ಆಹಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That monastery's food-donor gives food to the poor every day.

definition: a man who sees or saw (something).
example_en: The eyewitness of the incident told the police everything.

definition: to put in the ground and cover with earth or under the surface of water.
example_en: He put the seeds in the ground and covered them with earth.

definition: the lucid Kannaḍa language.
example_en: Because he spoke in lucid Kannada, everyone understood.

definition: a city in Uttar Pradesh, in North Eastern part of India, held by Hindus as a most holy city, popularly known as Kāś i.
example_en: The pilgrims went to Banaras to bathe in the Ganges.

definition: a person who is charged with imputation; an accused.
example_en: The accused stood before the court.
